vacancy.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Optics
vacancy.assessment: Previously untracked S&T official senior optical systems engineering opportunity in Delft. Leads multidisciplinary development of precision optical systems, telescopes, photonic instrumentation and space-related products, with integration and verification responsibility. Mechanical/optomechanical education and hands-on hardware project experience relevant, but explicitly requires 10+ years as systems engineer and specialised optics background, making this a senior stretch. Not direct ESTEC; salary unlisted.
